definitionZh: 突出显示组件以可视方式标记文本块中的匹配子字符串，支持纯字符串查询和预先计算的匹配范围。
sourceDefinition: The highlight component visually marks matching substrings within a block of text, supporting plain string queries and pre-computed match ranges.
